angle: Tyrion Lannister proves that intelligence and wit are more effective survival tools than physical strength in a violent world.
hook: Tyrion Lannister won by doing the thing everyone says to avoid.
points: In the series, Tyrion is an achondroplastic dwarf considered an embarrassment to his wealthy, powerful family.
He compensates for his physical limitations by using his intelligence and wit as a survival mechanism.
Despite being underestimated by everyone, he is arguably the most intelligent character in the entire cast.
Tyrion faced betrayal and lost his position, wealth, and family, forcing him to adapt to survive.
Lesson: In life, when you lack traditional power, your mind is your greatest weapon for survival.
closer: Are you relying on your strength or your mind to win?

evidence.hook: He knows he has no skills with the sword and this is a world that is really deeply violent. Military rules. He would not be able to survive in that world, given his own strength. So he beats people to the punchline—he's entertaining.
points: Tyrion is an actual dwarf, achondroplastic and stubby-limbed, a joke to passersby and an embarrassment to his family.

though he is probably the most intelligent character in the whole cast list—no one takes him seriously.
He's lost his position in House Lannister, he's lost his position in court, he's lost all of his gold – which is the one thing that's kind of sustained him

caption: Tyrion Lannister shows that being the smartest person in the room matters more than being the strongest. When the odds are stacked against you, your ability to adapt and outthink your opponents becomes your only real advantage. How are you sharpening your mind today?
